title: A positive free second-quantized Hamiltonian is compatible with the Gaussian cutoff tower

free_hamiltonian.one_particle_operator: omega is a positive diagonal self-adjoint operator on l2 with frequencies omega_j>=omega_0>0 and charge-stable eigenspaces
free_hamiltonian.second_quantization: H_0=dGamma(omega) is positive self-adjoint on symmetric Fock, essentially self-adjoint on the finite-particle core, and has vacuum kernel with spectral gap omega_0
free_hamiltonian.cutoff_compatibility: For spectral projections p_N commuting with omega and the charge generator, H_M J_NM=J_NM H_N on the finite-particle core and the cutoff resolvents converge strongly to the continuum resolvent
free_hamiltonian.compact_symmetry: H_0 strongly commutes with the residual U(1) representation and Haar projection, so it restricts self-adjointly to the invariant sector and descends to K1429 degree-zero cohomology
free_hamiltonian.brst_compatibility: On the tensor product core H_0 acts on reduced modes and commutes with the Gaussian gauge differential acting on the separate based-gauge factor
free_hamiltonian.boundary: This is a free repository Hamiltonian. It does not contain K1425's quartic interaction, control the K1413 nonlinear PDE leakage, or define a source-owned interacting physical Hamiltonian
